He also recorded the first hole-in-one in Olympic golf.Justin won his first major title when he took home the U.S. Open at Merion Golf Club in 2013. He reached No. 1 in the world for the first time in 2018.He was born in South Africa to English parents and his family moved to England when Rose was five years old.
